updateTo.name: Focal Lab 0.6.1
updateTo.notes:
Fixed the “Redirect was cancelled” error when downloading GitHub updates on macOS.
Kept the configured repository, allowed redirect host, archive-size check and SHA-256 verification for every update.
Includes all 0.6.0 features: five research priority sliders, Focal Lab default, editing preferences and saved report priorities.
Updated the manual installation instructions for existing Mac installations.

Versions 0.5.1 and 0.6.0 need this one-time repair from Open downloads: quit Focal Lab, extract the 0.6.1 ZIP, and open Install_Focal_Lab.command. The installer preserves the workspace and replaces the existing application.
Personal preview: Apple Developer ID signing and notarization remain pending.
Live ChatGPT research depends on account eligibility and service availability.

updateTo.name: Focal Lab 0.6.0
updateTo.notes:
Added five research sliders, starting with Focal Lab default. Adjust sharpness, aberration control, bokeh, flare, and distortion / corner brightness without entering percentages.
Added an editing preference for lens corrections, keeping native and corrected findings distinct.
Custom priorities guide best-fit research while preserving original measurements, evidence requirements, and uncertainty.
Saved priorities with each research report and separated cached results when priorities change. New lens selections start with Focal Lab default.
Kept the default 50 / 20 / 15 / 10 / 5 optical priorities and added a one-click reset. Updates remain available through Download and restart.
